item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of pieces of this tube_length that must be produced. Demands are integer counts that must be met (no shortages or extras) when planning cuts across bars.

global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of a single master roll (stock) in the same linear units as piece lengths. Each cut plan must not exceed this length per roll; the objective is to pack requested pieces into as few master_roll_length units as possible.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a print order type (a requested piece specification). Distinguishes different piece lengths/demands so the coordinator knows which cuts correspond to which orders.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact length required for each piece of this print order, expressed in the same units as master_roll_length. Each produced piece must match this section_length exactly.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The total number of pieces of this section_length that must be produced to satisfy the print orders. All pieces_required must be cut across the master rolls; the solution must meet these counts exactly.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of a single plank (stock plank) in the workshop. Every cut from a plank consumes length from this capacity; the sum of board lengths cut from any plank must not exceed this value.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a requested board specification (an order line). Use this id to distinguish board lengths and their quantities when planning cuts.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required length of one board piece of this type. Each piece cut of this type reduces the remaining length of the plank by this amount.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The number of pieces of this board type that must be produced exactly. The cutting plan must supply this many pieces of the given board_length.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of a single vinyl roll (the maximum linear length available to cut panels from one roll). All panel cuts from a roll must sum to no more than this length.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a requested sign panel type (e.g., style or size code) so the cutter can track different panel lengths and their required quantities.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required linear length of that panel type to be cut from the vinyl roll. Multiple panels of this length will be cut to meet the order demand.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of panels of this type that must be produced from the rolls (the order quantity). The cutting plan must produce this many and not produce extras.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The fixed length of one cable spool (maximum available cable per spool). All cuts assigned to a single spool must sum to no more than this length. Units match the requested run lengths.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A short identifier for a requested cable run type (e.g., label or code used to track that specific run length). Used to refer to that run when assigning cuts to spools.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required length of that cable run type. This is the length (in the same units as spool_length) of each piece that must be cut for that run_id.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The number of pieces of that run_length the shop must produce for customers. The solution must cut exactly this many pieces across all spools (no more, no fewer).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of a single glass sheet (the maximum total length of strips that can be cut from one sheet). All strip lengths are measured in the same units; cuts assigned to a sheet cannot exceed this value.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a particular strip type to be cut (used to distinguish demands and track produced pieces for that specific required length).

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of a single strip of this type, in the same units as the sheet length. Each cut yields exactly this length and consumes that amount from a sheet.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The total number of strips of this type that must be produced. The cutting plan must supply this many pieces (no shortages); excess production is not required.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The length of one full curtain rail (stock rail) available to cut, expressed in the same units as piece lengths. Every grouping of cuts assigned to a single rail must have a summed length less than or equal to this rail_length. The optimization goal is to cover all orders while minimizing how many rails of this length are used.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a requested rail piece type (for example an order line, SKU, or piece size label). Use this to distinguish different required piece lengths when building cutting patterns and counting produced pieces.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required length of a single rail piece of this type (in the same units as rail_length). Each cut that produces this type must be exactly this piece_length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of pieces of this piece_type_id that must be produced. The cutting plan must provide this many pieces in total across all rails (no shortfall and no surplus).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of one rope coil (in the same units as piece lengths). This is the maximum total length that may be cut from a single coil; no plan may allocate more length from a coil than this value.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a requested piece type (i.e., a particular requested rope length). Items with the same piece_type_id are interchangeable pieces of the same length.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required length of that piece type (the length to cut for each unit of this item), expressed in the same units as coil_length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The number of pieces of this piece_type_id that must be produced (the exact quantity of that length to supply to customers).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of a single hide (in the same length units as panel lengths). This is the maximum total length of panels that can be cut from one hide; cuts assigned to a hide must not sum to more than this value and each hide opened counts toward the objective to be minimized.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a panel order type. Use this id to reference a specific panel length and its required quantity when planning cuts from hides.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: Length of a single panel of this type (in the same units as hide_usable_length). Each produced panel consumes this amount of length from the hide it is cut from.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: Number of panels of this type that must be produced exactly. The cutting plan must yield this many pieces of this length (no shorting or overproduction).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of one fabric roll (in the same units as strip lengths). No cuts assigned to a roll may sum to more than this value; the objective is to minimize how many rolls are opened.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a requested strip specification (groups strips of identical length together). The solver uses this to distinguish different order lines.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of one strip of this type (in the same units as roll_length). Each produced piece of this type consumes this amount of roll length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The total number of strips of this strip_type_id that must be cut to satisfy orders. The solution must produce exactly this many pieces of the given strip_length.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The fixed length of each stock plastic rod/bar (in the same length units as part lengths). Each rod can be cut into pieces whose summed lengths do not exceed this value; the goal is to minimize how many rods are opened while meeting all orders.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A short identifier for a specific ordered part type (used to label sizes and counts in cut layouts).

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of a single piece of this part type (in the same units as the rod length). Each cut placed on a rod consumes this length from that rod.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of pieces of that part length that must be produced. All quantities must be met exactly (no more, no fewer) by the combined cuts on the rods.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The total length of one unopened stem bundle (the maximum length of stems that can be cut from a single bundle). For any bundle, the sum of the lengths of stems cut from it cannot exceed this value; leftover length is scrap. The optimization goal is to minimize how many such bundles are opened.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier or label for a requested stem type/size (e.g., 'A', 'red_rose_30cm', or numeric id). Used to distinguish different required stem lengths when listing cutting patterns and fulfilling demands.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required length of a single stem piece of this type. Each produced stem of this type consumes this amount of length from a bundle when cut.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of stems of this length that the florist must produce. The cutting plan must produce this many pieces of this stem_type_id in total (no more, no fewer).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The length of one full curtain pole (the standard stock size). This is the capacity limit for cuts from a single pole — the sum of piece lengths cut from any one stock pole cannot exceed this value.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a requested pole segment type (used to distinguish different requested lengths/orders).

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of that segment type (in the same units as the stock_pole_length) that must be cut from stock poles.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The number of pieces of that segment_length that must be produced to satisfy customer orders.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The available length of a single leather roll (in the chosen units). This is the maximum total length of strips that can be cut from one roll; no combination of strips assigned to a roll may exceed this value.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a requested strip type on the order sheet (used to track each distinct strip requirement).

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length consumed from a roll by one strip of this type (in the same units as roll_length). Each produced piece uses this exact amount of the roll.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of strips of this strip_length that must be cut to fulfill the order. The cutting plan must produce this many pieces for each strip_type_id.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The fixed length of each fabric bolt (stock length) measured in the chosen unit. This is the maximum total length available on a single bolt for cutting table runners; the sum of piece lengths cut from any bolt cannot exceed this value.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific table-runner order type (e.g., a particular length or style). All pieces with this id share the same requested length and demand.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required length of one table runner piece for this item type. Each cut must produce pieces of exactly this length, using the same units as bolt_length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The number of runner pieces of this runner_length that must be produced to fulfill event orders. Every demanded piece must be cut (no shortages or extras) across the bolts.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of one canvas bolt (in the same length units as panel lengths). This is the maximum total panel length that can be cut from a single bolt.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A short identifier for a panel type on the checklist (e.g., 'roof_panel', 'door_flap'). The foreman uses this to match a size to its required count.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required length of one piece of that panel type (measured in the same units as the bolt length). Each cut of this panel consumes this much length from a bolt.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of pieces of that panel type the tent maker must cut from the bolts. The cutting plan must produce this many pieces in total.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Total usable length of material on one full label roll (in the chosen length units). This is the maximum combined length of strips that can be cut from a single roll.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a specific label length request / customer order line. Distinguishes one required strip type from another.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: Required length of one strip for this label job (in the same units as label_roll_length). Each cut of this size counts toward that job's demand.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: Number of strips of the given label_strip_length that must be produced for this label_job_id. All units must be cut exactly to meet this quantity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of ribbon on a single spool (the stock length). When creating a cutting plan, the total length of pieces cut from any one spool cannot exceed this spool_length. The planner minimizes how many spools are opened.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a requested piece type or order line (e.g., SKU or order code). Distinguishes different required piece lengths so the planner knows which pieces to allocate to spools.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of a single piece to be cut for that order type (same units as spool_length). Each piece consumes this much length from whatever spool it is cut from.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The required number of pieces of that piece_length that must be produced to satisfy the customer's order. The planner must produce exactly this many pieces across all spools.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The total usable length of one vinyl roll (the maximum sum of plank lengths that can be cut from a single roll). All cutting patterns for a roll must not exceed this length; units must match the plank lengths.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a particular plank size/type (used to distinguish different required plank lengths in the cutting plan).

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of a single plank piece required for installation (the length to cut from a roll for that plank type). Must use the same units as roll_length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of planks of this plank_type_id and plank_length that must be produced for the job. The cutting plan must produce this many pieces, no more and no fewer.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The length of one standard dowel bar in stock (the maximum usable length per bar). All piece lengths are measured in the same units; this is the capacity that limits how many short dowel pieces can be cut from a single bar.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a required dowel segment type (for example a part number or label). Use this to distinguish different piece lengths and their separate demands when planning cuts.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of the short dowel piece to be produced for this part_id. This is the amount of stock length consumed by each piece and must use the same units as stock_bar_length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of pieces of this piece_length that must be produced for the run. The cutting plan must yield at least this many of each part (ideally exactly this many, with minimal wasted bars).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Total usable length of one standard adhesive tape reel (measured in the same length units used for strip lengths). This is the maximum continuous length available to cut from a single reel; leftover length on a reel can be used for further cuts on that same reel but does not increase capacity of other reels.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a requested strip type/order. Use this id to refer to a particular strip length and its required quantity when planning cuts.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: Length of one individual strip to be cut for this order (same units as reel_usable_length). Each produced piece consumes this exact length from a reel.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: Number of identical strips of this strip_length that must be produced to fulfill the order. The cutting plan must produce exactly this many pieces for each strip_type_id.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The length of one standard timber beam available for cutting (measured in the same units used for slat lengths). Each beam is one stock piece whose total cut lengths cannot exceed this value; the aim is to minimize how many of these beams are consumed.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier or label for a slat entry on the builder's cut list. Used to distinguish different slat sizes/types when assigning required pieces to timbers.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required length of a single slat of this type (must use the same length units as standard_timber_length). Each produced piece will be cut to this exact length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of slats of this type that must be produced from the timbers. Demands must be met exactly — no shortfalls and no extra pieces.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of a single paper roll (the stock) measured in the same units as signature lengths; each roll can be cut into signatures whose total length per roll cannot exceed this value, and the goal is to minimize how many whole rolls are consumed.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a signature type (a fixed-length piece to be cut for a particular print run); distinguishes different signature sizes and their separate demands.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of one signature of this type (in the same units as roll_length); each cut produces exactly this length and it counts toward the roll's length capacity.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: How many complete signatures of this type the bindery must produce in total for the job; all these units must be cut (no shortages, no extras) across the set of rolls used.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The full length of a single ceramic slab (stock length) measured in the same units as strip lengths; each slab cannot be used to cut pieces whose total lengths exceed this value.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a requested strip type (a customer order line) — used to distinguish strip lengths and track how many of that type are produced.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required length of a single strip piece for this item type (same units as slab_length); multiple pieces of this length will be cut from slabs to meet demand.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The number of strip pieces of this length that must be produced to satisfy customer orders; the planner must allocate cuts to slabs until this quantity is reached.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of one standard leather roll (the stock length). This is the maximum total length of straps that can be cut from a single roll; when planning cuts you must not exceed this per roll. Leftover scrap is permitted but does not count toward any demand.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a strap type (e.g., model code or size label). Used to distinguish different strap lengths and track which demand corresponds to which strap.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required length of one strap of this type, in the same unit as the roll_length. Each cut of this length consumes that amount from a roll's available length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The number of straps of this type the shoemaker must produce. All of these pieces must be cut from the rolls (no shortfalls); planning should allocate them across rolls to minimize the total rolls used.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The available length of one molding stick (in the same units used for piece lengths). This is the maximum continuous length you can cut from a single stick when planning cuts.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A short identifier for a particular side-piece type/length (used to distinguish different required piece sizes when organizing cuts).

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required length of that side piece (measured in the same units as the molding_stick_length). Each cut must produce pieces of this exact length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: How many pieces of this piece_length are needed in total to fulfill customer orders; the planner must produce exactly this many pieces of that type.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The length of one whole cured sausage log (the stock capacity) in the same units used for portion lengths. This is the maximum total length available to cut from a single log when forming portions.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier or label for a requested portion type (e.g., 'small', 'medium', or a numeric code). It distinguishes different portion lengths so the cutter knows which demand corresponds to which piece length.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required length of a single portion for this portion_label, in the same units as sausage_log_length. Each cut piece of this type must equal this length (no fractional pieces).

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The number of pieces of this portion_label that must be produced (an integer). The cutting plan must create exactly this many pieces of that portion_length across all logs.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The total usable length of one full fabric bolt (in the chosen unit, e.g., meters or centimeters). This is the maximum sum of piece lengths that can be cut from a single bolt.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific pattern piece type (e.g., 'sleeve_L', 'front_panel'). Used to track which pieces of that type must be cut from bolts.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length along the bolt that a single instance of this pattern piece consumes (same unit as bolt_length). Each cut of this length produces one piece of this type.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of pieces of this pattern type that must be produced (no more, no less). The planning must allocate cuts to bolts to meet this quantity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The full length of one raw standard rod (in the same length units used for pieces). This is the maximum total length that can be cut from a single rod — no combination of piece lengths assigned to one rod may exceed this value. The objective is to minimize how many of these standard rods are consumed.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a demanded bar/part type. Use this to distinguish different required lengths and to track how many of each part have been produced.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of one piece of this part type (in the same units as the standard rod). Each time this part is produced it consumes this length from a rod.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The number of pieces of this part length that must be produced in total. The cutting plan must produce at least this many pieces for each part_id.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Total usable length of a single uncut dough roll (in the chosen unit, e.g., cm or inches). The sum of loaf_length values cut from any one roll cannot exceed this length; each roll opened counts as one whole roll toward the objective of minimizing rolls used.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a loaf size/type (a label or code used to distinguish different loaf orders). This tells the baker which loaf specification each demand refers to when assigning cuts to rolls.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: Length of a single loaf of this type (same unit as dough_roll_length). Cutting one loaf of this type consumes this amount of length from the roll it is taken from.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: Exact number of loaves of this type that must be produced for the day's orders. The cutting plan must produce this many pieces of this loaf type in total (no extras, no shortfalls).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Length of one standard glass pane (stock) in the shop's measurement units. Every panel cut must be no longer than this length; the solver uses this to decide how many panels can be cut from a single pane while minimizing total panes used.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a particular panel size/order (e.g., a SKU or label). Use this to refer to the panel's required length and its demand.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: Required length of an individual panel of this type (in the same units as pane_length). Each panel of this length must fit entirely within a single pane.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: Exact number of panels of this panel_type_id that the shop must produce to meet customer orders. The cutting plan must produce this many pieces for each type.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of a single upholstery tube (the stock length). Every set of cushion strips cut from one tube must have summed lengths that do not exceed this tube_length. Units must match the strip widths on the order ticket.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier or label for a particular cushion strip type on the order ticket (e.g., 'A', 'B', or a part number). Used to distinguish sizes when planning cuts.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of one cushion strip of this type to be cut from a tube. This is the amount of tube length consumed by one piece of this item_type; its units must match tube_length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The number of cushion strips of this strip_type_id that must be supplied. The cutting plan must produce exactly this many pieces (no fewer, no extras).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of one cardboard roll (in the same units as the strip sizes). The sum of strip lengths cut from any single roll cannot exceed this value; the solver uses this capacity to determine how many rolls are required.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific box-face strip type (e.g., a SKU, code, or label) used on the cutting lists so pieces of different sizes can be distinguished.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of one strip of this type measured along the roll (same units as roll_length). Each cut of this type consumes this amount of a roll's capacity.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of strips of this type that must be produced for shipment. The cutting plan must produce this many pieces in total (no extras or shortages) while minimizing the number of rolls used.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of a single leather hide (the fixed stock length). All patches cut from one hide must sum to no more than this length; measured in the same linear units as patch lengths.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a patch type or shoe component (for example: sole_left, vamp_right). It distinguishes different patch sizes and counts on the cutting list.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The linear length along the hide consumed by a single patch of this type. This is the dimension summed when placing patches on a hide and must use the same units as hide_length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The number of patches of this type the shoemaker must produce. The cutting plan must supply at least this many pieces across all hides.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length (total width) of a single continuous drapery roll. Any set of panels cut from the same roll must have combined panel_widths that do not exceed this roll_length; the solver packs panels into rolls to minimize the number of rolls used.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a panel type or order line (distinct panel width grouping). Each panel_type_id groups panels that share the same panel_width and total panels_required.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The width of one curtain panel of this type. When assigning panels to a roll, the sum of panel_width values for that roll must not exceed roll_length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The total number of panels of this panel_type_id that must be produced (the order quantity). The solver must allocate this many panels across rolls while minimizing the total rolls used.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of one original label strip (in the same linear units as label lengths). Each cut pattern placed on a single strip must have total piece lengths ≤ this value; minimizing the number of strips used is the objective.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier (SKU or type code) for a particular label order/design/length that must be cut from the strips.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required linear length of one piece of this label type (in the same units as label_strip_length); pieces of this length are produced by cutting the strips.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The total number of pieces of this label type that must be produced to satisfy orders (an integer count that must be met or exceeded by the cutting plan).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Length of one full standard metal channel (stock length). This is the maximum total length of flange pieces that can be cut from a single channel; units must match the flange lengths.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a specific flange piece type required for assemblies (distinguishes pieces by their length or part code).

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: Length of a single flange piece to be cut from a channel (in the same units as channel_length); each piece of this type consumes this amount of channel length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: Total number of flange pieces of this flange_id that must be produced to satisfy assembly needs; the solver must produce at least this many pieces in aggregate.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The full usable length of one leather strap (stock). All cuts placed on a single strap must sum to no more than this length; units must match the piece lengths.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific belt-piece type/order line. Used to distinguish different lengths and to track which pieces' demands must be fulfilled.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of one belt piece of this type that must be cut from a strap. Each cut of this type consumes this amount from a strap; units must be the same as strap_length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of pieces of this belt-piece type that must be produced. The cutting plan must include exactly this many cuts of the given piece_length.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Total usable length of a single yarn beam (in the same length units used for piece lengths). The sum of all piece lengths cut from any one beam cannot exceed this value; beams are the resources we try to minimize.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a requested yarn piece type or project component. Pieces with the same piece_id are identical and interchangeable when satisfying demand.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: Length of yarn required for a single piece of this type (use the same units as beam_length). Each time this piece is produced it consumes this length from a beam.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: Number of pieces of this type that must be produced. The cutting plan must yield at least this many pieces of the specified piece_length.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The fixed usable length of one plastic sheet (in the same unit as panel lengths). The sum of panel lengths cut from a single sheet cannot exceed this value; the solver uses it to determine how many panels fit on each sheet and to minimize total sheets used.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier (SKU or code) for a pouch panel variant. Distinguishes different panel sizes so the planner knows which demand and length apply to each panel type.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of the pouch panel measured along the cutting direction of the sheet (same unit as sheet_length). When mapping cuts, the lengths of panels placed on one sheet are summed and must not exceed sheet_length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of panels of this type that must be produced. The cutting plan must produce this quantity in total (no shortfalls and no unnecessary extras).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The fixed length of one fabric bolt (the maximum total width of panels that can be cut from a single bolt). All panel widths assigned to a bolt must sum to at most this length; the seamstress wants to minimize how many bolts of this length she uses.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: An identifier for a specific curtain panel type/order. Each distinct panel_type_id refers to panels that share the same required width and quantity.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required width of a single panel of this type. When planning cuts, each panel of this type consumes this amount of length from a bolt.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: How many panels of this type the seamstress must produce exactly. The plan must include this exact number of panels (no shortages or extras).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of one raw stock board (in the workshop's length units). Each cutting pattern applied to a board cannot exceed this length; solver uses this as the capacity to pack shelf pieces while minimizing the number of boards used.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a requested shelf type (size request). Used to track which shelf lengths and counts belong together so the cutting plan produces the exact requested pieces per type.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required length of one shelf piece of this type. Multiple pieces of various shelf_length values may be cut from a single board as long as their total length per board does not exceed board_length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of shelf pieces of this shelf_type_id that must be produced. The cutting plan must meet these counts exactly (no shortfalls and no surplus); the objective is to satisfy all required_quantity values using the fewest boards.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Total usable thickness (or usable length) of a single dough log measured in the same units as layer thickness; the sum of thicknesses of all layers cut from one log cannot exceed this value.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a requested cake layer type (groups all layers that share the same thickness and order). Use this ID to track which demand each slice satisfies.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: Thickness of one cake layer of this type, in the same units as log_thickness_capacity; each slice of this type consumes this much thickness from a dough log.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: Exact number of individual layers of this thickness the baker must produce to fulfill orders; the cutting plan must supply this many slices of the corresponding layer_type_id (no shortfalls and no unnecessary extras).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of a single paper roll (in the same units as poster widths). This is the maximum total width that can be cut from one roll; any unused leftover is waste. Solvers use this to decide how many posters can be cut from each roll.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A short identifier for a poster order type (e.g., SKU or label). Distinguishes different poster widths and their separate demands.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The width of one poster of this type (in the same units as paper_roll_length). Each cut consumes this amount from a roll.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of posters of this type that must be produced. The cutting plan must meet this count for each poster_type_id without overproducing.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The fixed length of a single glass rod (the stock length available for cutting). All piece lengths are measured in the same units; each rod can yield pieces whose total lengths do not exceed this value. The solver packs piece cuts into rods and aims to minimize how many rods are consumed.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a decorative piece type (an index or code the glazier uses). Use this id to refer to that piece size and its required count when planning cuts.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of this decorative piece that must be cut from rods. Measured in the same units as rod_length; each piece of this length consumes that much of a rod when cut.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of pieces of this type the glazier needs. The cutting plan must produce at least this many pieces (no underproduction); the objective is to meet all these quantities while minimizing rods used.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The total usable length of one leather roll (the stock length / capacity). Measured in the same units as the strap piece sizes; each cut consumes that much length from a roll.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific strap type. Used to link a strap's required size and how many pieces of that type are needed.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length along the roll that a single strap piece consumes when cut (i.e., the piece size that reduces the roll's remaining length). Must use the same units as roll_length.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of pieces of this strap type that must be produced from the rolls. All required_quantity values must be met without over- or under-producing.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Length of one standard full-length stock pipe the plumber has available (in the chosen unit). Each set of cuts assigned to a single stock pipe cannot exceed this length.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a required pipe section type. Used to refer to a specific required piece length and its required quantity when planning cuts.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: Required length of that pipe section type (in the same unit as stock_pipe_length). Each produced piece of this type must equal this length exactly.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: Exact number of pieces of this section_length the plumber must produce. All of these must be cut (no shortfalls or overproduction).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The fixed usable length of one leather strip (in the chosen unit, e.g. centimeters). Each strip you cut from cannot supply pieces whose summed lengths exceed this value; leftover length on a strip is waste. This is the stock length you are trying to cover with pattern pieces while minimizing the number of strips consumed.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a pattern piece type (e.g., 'toe_piece', 'heel_tab', or a numeric ID). Used to distinguish different piece types when assigning cuts to strips.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The required length of that pattern piece (in the same unit as strip_length). Each individual piece of this type consumes this amount of length from a strip when cut.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of pieces of this pattern type that must be produced. The cutting plan must provide this many pieces (no fewer and — per the scenario constraint — not extra copies beyond what's needed).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The fixed length of each foam log (in the chosen units). This is the maximum total length of padding blocks that can be cut from a single log; when planning cuts the sum of block lengths assigned to one log cannot exceed this value. The solver tries to cover all demands using as few foam logs of this length as possible.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier on an order slip for a particular padding block specification. It distinguishes different block types (i.e., different required lengths) so the supervisor knows which demand counts belong together when assigning cuts to logs.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length of one padding block of this type (in the same units as the foam_log_length). Cutting plans produce pieces of exactly this length to satisfy the corresponding order slip.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of padding blocks of this block_type_id that must be produced. The cutting plan must produce this many pieces of block_length across all foam logs, with each piece counted once and no extras or shortfalls.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of one standard matboard sheet that the framer will cut from; when planning cuts, the sum of piece widths placed on a single sheet cannot exceed this length.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A short identifier for a requested mat type/size (used to distinguish different requested mats on the order sheet); each id refers to a specific width and demand that must be produced.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The length/width taken from the matboard by one piece of this mat size (how much of a sheet’s length one mat of this type consumes when cut).

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of mats of this size the framer must produce from the stock sheets; the cutting plan must meet this count exactly (no shortages and no accidental extras).

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Length of a single stock wooden plank available for cutting (the standard plank length). This is the usable capacity per plank; when planning cuts the sum of rib lengths taken from one plank cannot exceed this length. Specify units (e.g., meters, inches) consistent with rib lengths.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a rib type (for example an alphanumeric code or sequential number). Associates a required length and quantity so the cutter knows which demand corresponds to which rib specification.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: Length of one rib of this type (in the same units as plank_length). Each produced piece of this length fulfills one unit of the corresponding demand.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: Number of ribs of the specified rib_id and rib_length that must be produced. The cutting plan must yield exactly this many pieces of that type while minimizing the total number of planks used.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The usable length of a single aluminum sheet (the fixed stock capacity). All blank widths placed on one sheet must sum to no more than this value; it is used to determine how many full sheets are consumed.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific sign blank type/order. Use this ID to reference the blank's width and required quantity when planning cuts.

item_fields.name: width
item_fields.scenario_description: The width of the sign blank (in the same units as sheet_length). Each produced piece consumes this amount of length from a sheet.

item_fields.name: demand
item_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of pieces of this blank_width that must be produced. The cutting plan must meet this demand exactly (no shortages or overproduction) while minimizing sheets used.
